verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents an official Importer plugin. It converts a Notion workspace to Markdown and preserves Notion databases and formulas as Bases. The import docs also list Evernote, OneNote and Airtable, and plain Markdown works natively because vaults are Markdown files. A Roam switcher reports migrating, but no Roam importer is documented. missing for 10: documented Roam import path, explicit evidence that internal links and attachments survive import, independent hands-on corroboration of import fidelity.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved

citations.quote: Obsidian lets you easily migrate your data from Notion using the Importer plugin. This converts your Notion workspace to durable Markdown files
lets you preserve Databases and formulas which are converted to Bases
Obsidian stores your notes as Markdown-formatted plain text files in a vault.
